notes: Non-private hard gate for learned compatibility groups. Training and unseen test vehicles are separate. Parameter clustering uses normalized log-ratios. Control-aware clustering uses the same public nominal-center diagonal geometry for every client and therefore does not require family labels. K is selected by maximum training silhouette over K=2..8 subject to minimum cluster size; K=1 is selected if no admissible candidate reaches silhouette 0.25. FixedK3 is a baseline. The gate requires learned-K control-aware tracking no worse than oracle-family tracking, full amplitude feasibility, frozen rho below one, and fewer deployed models than Local. Simulator family labels are used only for oracle comparison and ARI diagnostics.
